blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel has no issue with Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio, supporting young athletes, but lawyer Benjamin Tolosa Jr. clarified that questions had to be asked of a defense witness whose testimony touched on credit card expenses discussed before. In a press briefing on Thursday, Tolosa, one of the private lawyers on the prosecution side, explained that there was never a discussion on whether parents should support their children’s ventures into sports, as the topic remains Duterte’s unexplained wealth.
